editionData.title: Trump arrives in Manila as Southeast Asia navigates U.S.-China rivalry; Brazilian federal police are investigating JD Vance donor...
editionData.description: Global headlines: Trump arrives in Manila as Southeast Asia navigates U.S.-China rivalry (Ahead of a trip to China, President Donald Trump showed up to a summit of Southeast Asian leaders just as it was ending. Nonetheless, he loomed over the talks); Brazilian federal police are investigating JD Vance donor network (The probe has drawn renewed attention to the uncommon political partnership between MAGA and the Bolsonaro-led Brazilian right); and Mexican drug kingpin depicted in ‘Narcos’ dies in prison (Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo was the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration’s most wanted man in Mexico after the 1985 torture-murder of a DEA agent). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Carnegie Mellon is putting computer science courses on YouTube for free (Free lectures from Carnegie Mellon); BugMeNot has closed (Thanks to everyone who envisioned a better internet); and Nimony: A New Compiler for Nim (Built every day from nimony’s master branch). Product Hunt features Ballet (Deterministic AI workflow automation for Ops teams), Lampa Camera (iPhone camera with natural processing and an analog feel), and Lasso (Draw on your Mac screen, then let AI agents see it).
editionData.author: Sony Mathew

headlines.title: Trump arrives in Manila as Southeast Asia navigates U.S.-China rivalry
headlines.summary: Ahead of a trip to China, President Donald Trump showed up to a summit of Southeast Asian leaders just as it was ending. Nonetheless, he loomed over the talks.

headlines.title: Brazilian federal police are investigating JD Vance donor network
headlines.summary: The probe has drawn renewed attention to the uncommon political partnership between MAGA and the Bolsonaro-led Brazilian right.

headlines.title: Mexican drug kingpin depicted in ‘Narcos’ dies in prison
headlines.summary: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo was the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration’s most wanted man in Mexico after the 1985 torture-murder of a DEA agent.

headlines.title: Five European countries agree to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda
headlines.summary: The E.U. is adopting its most hard-line asylum rules yet, echoing some policies of the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Critics blame U.S.-Iran war for crackdown on clerics in Bahrain
headlines.summary: Dozens of Shiite clerics were sentenced to life in prison for allegedly working with Iran to undermine Bahrain. Their supporters say they are being punished for their faith.

headlines.title: Iran’s IRGC launches new attack; Several vessels struck in Strait of Hormuz
headlines.summary: IRGC says it launched drone attack on US radar system at Bahrain's Isa Air Base as at least three vessels hit in Hormuz.

headlines.title: Ukraine drone attack kills two in Crimea as Kyiv targets bridge to Russia

headlines.title: Bahrain thwarts drone attack; Iran claims targeting US radar

headlines.title: Irish court jails man for life over Dublin knife attack that sparked riots
headlines.summary: Three children and a woman were injured in the attack outside a central Dublin school in 2023.

headlines.title: Ukraine holds peace talks with US, Europe as conflict escalates
headlines.summary: Kushner reports progress towards a deal, but Moscow says it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

headlines.title: Do school cellphone bans work? New study says yes – but it's complicated
headlines.summary: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.

headlines.title: More people are getting the flu. Should you get a flu shot before you travel?
headlines.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, just as millions of Americans are expected to travel for the holidays. Another thing that's upon us? Cold and flu season.

headlines.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
headlines.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

headlines.title: Russia downs over 1,400 Ukrainian drones as Kyiv hits a key bridge in Crimea
headlines.summary: Ukraine's forces targeted a key rail and road bridge between Russia and the Crimean Peninsula for a second day. Moscow's forces, meanwhile, fired ballistic missiles and drones at Kyiv.

headlines.title: Morning news brief
headlines.summary: The FAA says it will rethink how it upgrades its aging system after nationwide ground stop, Trump to hold joint summit with leaders of China and Russia, Silicon Valley reacts to Nvidia scandal.

headlines.title: Shenzhen welcomes foreign officials for key meeting
headlines.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo arrived in Shenzhen, in South China's Guangdong province, on Monday, marking the start of a series of arrivals by leaders of the economies for the 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.

headlines.title: Families help legacy soar higher
headlines.summary: An exhibition commemorating the 85th anniversary of the Flying Tigers in China opened on Saturday in San Francisco, bringing together descendants whose family stories preserve memories of wartime service, affection for the Chinese people and hopes for peace.

headlines.title: APEC has role in combating protectionism
headlines.summary: Former New Zealand prime minister Jenny Shipley has highlighted the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum's vital role in combating global protectionism.

headlines.title: Britain has lost more than gained since Brexit: PM
headlines.summary: LONDON -- Britain has lost more than gained since the Brexit referendum in 2016, and the Brexit is "not good enough" for Britain, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday.

headlines.title: Closer Sino-Australian ties expected
headlines.summary: China's hosting of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum has raised expectations among Australian observers for closer bilateral cooperation, particularly in trade, clean energy and artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Census 2027 turning out to be farce: Congress
headlines.summary: Congress claims Census 2027 is a farce with grave implications, citing data glitches and dubious intent in India's census process.

headlines.title: Cyclone 'Akvan' LIVE updates: Akvan to become a severe cyclone tonight
headlines.summary: The deep depression over the southeast and southwest Bay of Bengal intensified into Cyclonic Storm Akvan on Monday (November 16, 2026) evening and is moving north-northwestward towards the Andhra Pradesh coast.

headlines.title: IOC gets government nod for commercial sustainable aviation fuel supply from Panipat refinery
headlines.summary: IOC wins government nod to commercially supply SAF from Panipat refinery, aiming to meet 2027 international flight blending targets via airline agreements.

headlines.summary: Modi urges ASEAN leaders to choose cooperation over competition, reaffirming India's steadfast partnership and shared goals for a peaceful, prosperous Indo-Pacific.
